description.en: Registers a character name substitution for the given placeholder index, so the next opened message can embed a character's name (identified by its CRC32 hash, see CMND_GET_HASH) at that placeholder.
Index of the name placeholder within the message text to substitute.
CRC32 hash identifying the character whose name to insert.
Optional; whether to use the character's full name.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Substitute a character's name into the next message's placeholder 0
CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA(0, CMND_GET_HASH(_aParamID[idx]), true);
